recentItems.title: PAYBACK FOR TERROR: “PELIKAN” BURNS RUSSIA’S MAIN PLANT! NEW UKRAINIAN DRONE DESTROYS “GERAN-5”!
recentItems.description:
A massive Gazprom Neft facility that supplies fuel to the Russian capital and the Russian military has caught fire in Moscow, while the Kremlin’s air defences have once again proved powerless against the strikes.

Meanwhile, the United States and the European Union are allocating nearly $6 billion to significantly strengthen Ukraine’s air defence, providing new missiles, launchers, and advanced radars to create an impenetrable shield over Ukrainian cities.

At the same time, a breakthrough has taken place in the skies above the battlefield: Ukraine’s newest high-speed interceptor drone has, for the first time in direct combat, caught up with and destroyed the enemy’s prized weapon — a jet-powered “Geran-5” cruise missile-drone.

0:00 — Intro
0:37 — Strikes on the Bashneft refinery in Ufa and the Moscow Oil Refinery in Kapotnya
3:20 — Russia’s fuel crisis and record petrol imports from Belarus
4:09 — Nearly $6 billion from the US and EU for air defence, and the loan programme involving Canada
5:29 — Zelenskyy’s phone call with Trump and ISW’s clarification
6:59 — Preparations for the “Drone Deal” with Iceland and the success of Ukraine’s homegrown interceptor
8:39 — New Ukrainian defence-industry technologies against jet-powered drones and missiles

recentItems.title: MOSCOW ROUTED: Ukrainian drones breach FOUR AIR-DEFENCE LAYERS protecting Russia’s capital!
recentItems.description:

While Russian air defences fail to stop strikes in the heart of their own country, Ukraine’s Defence Forces are breaking through the occupiers’ positions in the Lyman direction — liberating territory, eliminating enemy infantry, and destroying its logistics and ammunition depots.

recentItems.title: OPERATION VIVALDI: four stages to destroy the Russian army. Jet drones burned the YANOS giant
recentItems.description:
Russia is retreating. In this new episode, we examine the beginning of Ukraine’s counteroffensive in Donetsk region, codenamed “Vivaldi” and designed around the “four seasons.”

The enemy’s rear is on fire: Ukrainian long-range and cutting-edge jet-powered drones have struck the Slavneft-YANOS oil giant in Yaroslavl, as well as Russian military airfields.

The episode also covers Kyiv’s position on an “energy truce” ahead of winter and the turmoil in NATO after a Russian drone crashed in Volyn Oblast, near the border with Poland.

This video is partially translated using AI-based program.
